system_instruction:
system_instruction: 'You are a finance analyst supporting FP&A at Harborline Supply Co. Be concise and
  always state

  the fiscal period used. Finance managers comfortable with accounting terms, not SQL.'
glossaries:
- glossary:
  - term: collection days
  - description: Use payments.days_sales_outstanding.
  - synonyms:
    - time to collect
- glossary:
  - term: returns ratio
  - description: Use orders.refund_rate.
  - synonyms: []
- glossary:
  - term: Active Customer
  - description: A non-test customer with at least one non-deleted order in the period. (derived from
      catalog:active_customer; field orders.active_customer_count)
  - synonyms:
    - active customers
    - buying customers
- glossary:
  - term: Customer
  - description: A business that buys from Harborline, identified by its legal company name. (derived
      from catalog:customer; field customers.company_name)
  - synonyms:
    - customer name
    - account
- glossary:
  - term: Customer Segment
  - description: Enterprise, Mid-Market or SMB, based on annual spend band. (derived from catalog:customer_segment;
      field customers.segment)
  - synonyms:
    - segment
- glossary:
  - term: Days Sales Outstanding
  - description: Average days from invoice date to payment date for paid invoices. (derived from catalog:days_sales_outstanding;
      field payments.days_sales_outstanding)
  - synonyms:
    - dso
    - days to pay
- glossary:
  - term: Fiscal Quarter
  - description: A three-month period of the Harborline fiscal year, which starts February 1. "Last quarter"
      means the last completed fiscal quarter. (derived from catalog:fiscal_quarter; field created_fiscal.fiscal_quarter_label)
  - synonyms:
    - quarter
    - fiscal qtr
- glossary:
  - term: Fiscal Year
  - description: February 1 to January 31, named by the calendar year in which it ends (FY2026 = Feb 2025
      to Jan 2026). (derived from catalog:fiscal_year; field created_fiscal.fiscal_year)
  - synonyms:
    - fy
- glossary:
  - term: Gross Revenue
  - description: Sum of order line amounts before discounts and refunds. (derived from catalog:gross_revenue;
      field orders.gross_revenue)
  - synonyms:
    - gross sales
    - bookings
- glossary:
  - term: Net Revenue
  - description: Gross order revenue minus discounts minus refunds, attributed to the order date. This
      is the company's default meaning of "revenue" and "sales". (derived from catalog:net_revenue; field
      orders.net_revenue)
  - synonyms:
    - revenue
    - sales
    - net sales
    - turnover
- glossary:
  - term: Order Count
  - description: Number of orders, excluding test accounts and soft-deleted orders. (derived from catalog:order_count;
      field orders.order_count)
  - synonyms:
    - orders
    - number of orders
    - order volume
- glossary:
  - term: Recognized Revenue
  - description: Invoiced amount recognized on the invoice date, excluding void invoices. (derived from
      catalog:recognized_revenue; field invoices.recognized_revenue)
  - synonyms:
    - invoiced revenue
    - billed revenue
- glossary:
  - term: Refund Rate
  - description: Refunds attributed to the order period divided by gross revenue. (derived from catalog:refund_rate;
      field orders.refund_rate)
  - synonyms:
    - refund percentage
- glossary:
  - term: Region
  - description: Sales region of the customer. "Pacific NW" is a legacy spelling of "Pacific Northwest".
      (derived from catalog:region; field regions.region_name)
  - synonyms:
    - sales region
    - territory
additional_descriptions:

- text: '[fiscal-quarter] "Last quarter" means the last completed fiscal quarter; the fiscal year starts
    February 1.'
- text: '[fiscal-year] "Last year" means the last completed fiscal year (FY2026 = Feb 2025 to Jan 2026).'
- text: '[last-month] "Last month" means the last completed calendar month.'
- text: '[exclude-test-accounts] Never include test accounts or soft-deleted orders, even when asked for
    all data.'
- text: '[state-the-period] Always state the time period an answer covers.'
- text: '[sales-means-net] "Sales" and "net sales" mean net revenue.'
- text: '[quarter-is-fiscal] "Quarter" means fiscal quarter.'
- text: '[recognized-by-invoice-date] "Recognized revenue" means recognized revenue; report it by invoice
    date.'

    or contact name.'
